title: CDT-0029 Enterprise Cyber Risk Assessment Officer (NS) - THU 19 Nov
description: Deadline Date: Thursday 19 November 2026 Requirement: Enterprise Cyber Risk Assessment Officer Location: Brussels, BE Full Time On-Site: Yes Total Scope of the request (hours): 1780 (Estimate) Required Start Date: 4 January 2027 End Contract Date: 31 December 2027 Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET Special Terms and Conditions: The contractor will be responsible for complying with the respective national requirements for working permits, visas, taxes, social security etc. whilst working on site at NATO HQ Brussels, Belgium. No special status is either conferred or implied by the host organisation, NATO HQ Brussels, Belgium to the contractor whilst working on site. The contractor will be responsible for complying with all the respective National Health regulations in Belgium before taking up the position. 1. INTRODUCTION The Cyber and Digital Transformation Division (CDT) leads NATO’s digital transformation, cybersecurity and cyber defence efforts, translating NATO priorities into coherent strategies and coordinated delivery across the Alliance to strengthen interoperability, resilience, cybersecurity and operational effectiveness. CDT drives NATO’s Digital Transformation, a key objective is to strengthen the ability of Allies and the NATO Enterprise to deter, defend against and counter the full spectrum of cyber and cyber-enabled threats at the speed of relevance, comprehensively across the political, military, and technical levels. In particular, strengthen mechanisms and tools to enhance readiness and resilience against cyber threats across the Alliance, focusing in particular on Mission Vital Infrastructure (MVI). This position contributes to the Cyber Risk Management function of CDT, supporting the risk-informed decision-making process of the ECISOA. It provides specialist analysis and advice to inform CDT leadership’s cybersecurity decisions across the Division’s areas of responsibility. The Enterprise Cyber Risk Assessment Officer supports NATO’s enterprise-wide governance of cyber, cloud, artificial intelligence (AI), and ICT risks through the conduct of system-, service-, and enterprise-level risk assessments and the delivery of both qualitative and quantitative risk analysis. The role contributes to the continued development and implementation of the NATO Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework, ensuring that technical, operational, and strategic risks are identified, assessed, prioritised, and communicated to support risk-informed decision-making across the NATO Enterprise. The position has a particular emphasis on cyber risk management within cloud and AI-enabled environments, supporting the secure adoption of emerging technologies while ensuring that associated risks are effectively governed and aligned with NATO security and operational requirements. It will contribute to the assessment of complex digital services, the integration of risk management processes across NATO CIS Operational Authorities (CISOAs), and the enhancement of enterprise-wide visibility of cyber risk. Working directly with CDT in its role as NATO Enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Owner, the incumbent will help strengthen situational awareness, governance, resilience, and decision-making across NATO’s digital ecosystem. We are seeking a highly motivated professional with strong analytical, technical, and communication skills, as well as experience in cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, cloud technologies, and AI governance. Knowledge of NATO structures and processes would be considered an asset. 2. TASKS 2.1 Enterprise Cyber Risk Assessment and Analysis Description: Conduct and support CIS and Enterprise-level cyber risk assessments across NATO ICT, cloud, digital, and AI-enabled capabilities. Perform both qualitative and quantitative risk analysis to identify, assess, prioritize, and communicate risks affecting NATO operations, mission objectives, and Mission Vital Infrastructure (MVI). Develop risk assessment methodologies, evaluate risk scenarios, analyse risk interdependencies, and support risk-informed decision making in accordance with the NATO Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework. Measurement: Success will be measured through the quality, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of risk assessments, risk analyses, risk treatment recommendations, and decision-support products delivered to stakeholders. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 2.2 Enterprise Cyber, Cloud and AI Risk Governance Support Description: Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the NATO Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework and associated governance processes. Ensure the integration of cyber, ICT, cloud, artificial intelligence (AI), vulnerability, threat, and operational risk information into enterprise risk management activities. Conduct and support risk assessments related to cloud services, emerging technologies, AI-enabled systems, automation platforms, and digital transformation initiatives. Contribute to the development of risk methodologies, taxonomies, metrics, reporting standards, risk treatment approaches, and governance procedures that enable consistent risk identification, assessment, prioritisation, and reporting across the NATO Enterprise. Support the secure and responsible adoption of cloud and AI capabilities by ensuring that associated risks are appropriately identified, documented, monitored, and communicated to relevant risk owners and decision-making authorities. Contribute to the development of governance artefacts, risk recommendations, and decision-support products aligned with NATO security and operational requirements. Measurement: Success will be measured through the quality and timeliness of risk assessments, governance artefacts, methodologies, risk management products, framework enhancements, and stakeholder acceptance of delivered outputs and recommendations. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 2.3 Risk Registry and Enterprise Risk Visibility Support Description: Support the maintenance, enhancement, and utilisation of enterprise risk management tools, risk registries, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities. Ensure accurate registration, tracking, monitoring, and reporting of cyber, cloud, AI, and ICT risks. Maintain traceability between technical findings, vulnerabilities, threat assessments, risk treatment actions, risk acceptance decisions, and enterprise risk reporting. Measurement: Success will be measured through the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of risk registry updates, dashboard outputs, reporting products, and management information provided to stakeholders. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 2.4 Enterprise Cyber Risk Situational Awareness and Reporting Description: Support enterprise-wide cyber risk situational awareness by consolidating and analysing information from risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, operational reporting, threat intelligence, audits, security reviews, and accreditation activities. Produce dashboards, risk posture reports, trend analyses, executive summaries, and briefing materials to support operational and strategic decision making across NATO. Measurement: Success will be measured through the timely delivery of accurate risk posture reports, situational awareness products, executive briefings, and management recommendations. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 2.5 Stakeholder Management and Coordination Description: Engage and coordinate multiple stakeholders (technical teams, service owners, risk owners, operational authorities, security/accreditation stakeholders) across locations to align on security requirements, risk posture, and delivery priorities. Prepare and deliver briefings and decision-support materials. Measurement: Success will be measured by the effective and timely feedback provided by and to stakeholders on different documents and products. Accurate reports and products are required. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 2.6 Reporting, Briefings, and Technical Communication Description: Prepare and deliver briefings, presentations, and reports to NATO committees, Capability Panels, and working groups, clearly communicating technical concepts, progress, and recommendations related to cyber security standards. Measurement: Success will be measured by the timely delivery of high-quality reports and presentations, documented briefings, and stakeholder feedback demonstrating clarity, relevance, and effectiveness of communication. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 2.7 Support to Unforeseen and Ad Hoc Requirements. Description: The contractor shall provide support to unforeseen or ad hoc requirements within the scope of cyber security, Cloud, AI, and interoperability as requested and prioritised by CDT. Such support shall be subject to mutual agreement on scope, effort, and priority. Measurement: Success will be measured by the timely and effective delivery of agreed support activities, as documented in tasking requests, and acceptance of outputs by CDT. Timeline: Continuously throughout the period of performance. 3. PROFILE [See Requirements] 4. LOCATION OF DUTY The contractor will be embedded within CDT, working within the Cyber and Operations Section (CYOP) from the Readiness and Operations Directorate (ROPD), in close coordination with the other CDT sections, NATO Office of Security, NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA), Capability Panels, and other stakeholders. The duty location is NATO HQ in Brussels, Belgium. The contractor is expected to work 5 days a week on site and may perform in specific (but very limited in frequency) situations teleworking at his residence in Belgium, following a security assessment of the place. No teleworking is allowed outside of the respective residence in Belgium. 5. TIMELINES The services of the contractor are required for the period starting 04th January 2027 until 31th December 2027. A contract extension is possible for the calendar year 2028. The contract extension will be subject to performance of the contractor and related NATO regulations and budget availability. 6. SPECIFIC WORKING CONDITIONS The work will be performed in an office-based environment within a secure setting, under standard working hours. Occasional non-standard working hours may be required to support urgent or high-priority tasks. 7. LINK TO CDT OBJECTIVES The Enterprise Cyber Risk Assessment Officer directly supports Accreditation at the speed of relevance by providing timely, evidence-based risk assessments and risk treatment recommendations to inform accreditation and risk acceptance decisions by the relevant authorities. By maintaining traceability between technical findings, operational impacts, treatment actions, and residual risks, the role supports continuous assurance and enables decision-makers to prioritise mitigation measures in line with mission requirements and evolving threats. The position also supports the Interoperable Transatlantic Warfighting Cloud by assessing cyber risks associated with cloud services, interconnected systems, and shared dependencies across the NATO Enterprise. Through the analysis of risk scenarios, cross-service interdependencies, and potential operational impacts, the role informs the secure adoption and governance of cloud-enabled capabilities, supporting resilience, interoperability, and trusted information sharing across the Alliance. In addition, the role contributes to An AI Enabled Alliance by assessing and communicating cyber risks associated with AI-enabled systems, automation, and data-driven capabilities. By integrating these assessments into enterprise risk registers, reporting, and governance processes, the role supports the secure and responsible adoption of AI and enables relevant risk owners to make informed decisions on risk treatment, acceptance, and ongoing monitoring. 8. TRAVEL The contractor will be expected to undertake business travel in support of specification development and coordination with security engineering stakeholders across NATO entities. Travel expenses will be reimbursed to the individual directly (in addition to the hourly rate) under NATO rules. Travel to Shape will not be reimbursed. 9. SECURITY AND NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT The contractor must be in possession of a NATO SECRET security clearance before being considered as a candidate. A signed Non-Disclosure Agreement will be required. 3. PROFILE The awardee must hold a NATO SECRET Security Clearance. The candidate must possess a university degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science, systems science, cyber security, or an equivalent technical qualification/experience. The candidate must have comprehensive knowledge of computer and network security principles, networking technologies, and the vulnerabilities affecting modern operating systems, applications, cloud services, and enterprise platforms. The candidate must have demonstrated experience in vulnerability management, cyber exposure management or cyber risk management. The candidate shall have demonstrable experience in vulnerability analysis, root cause analysis, and risk assessment, including mapping technical findings to business or operational impact. The candidate must have experience working with vulnerability management tools, risk management platforms, dashboards, or GRC solutions. The candidate should have experience in securing cloud-based environments and understanding cloud-specific security risks. The candidate must have experience in the management or delivery of cybersecurity programmes across multiple focus areas, including vulnerability management, risk management, and cyber defence. The candidate must have demonstrated experience working within cross- functional teams and complex reporting structures. The candidate must demonstrate strong English writing and speaking communication and presentation skills, including the ability to convey complex cyber security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. The candidate must demonstrate a strong security-focused and analytical mindset, with attention to detail and problem-solving capability. Knowledge of NATO Security Policy and its supporting Directives is desirable. Knowledge of NATO CIS Security Accreditation processes, or equivalent national processes, is desirable. Recognised professional certifications in cyber security, risk management, or project management are desirable.

title: Research and Development Engineer in Formal Methods - 12 months contract
description: Who we are ? Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools. The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment. Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios. A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines. Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool. Your main responsibilities will include : Carry out R&D work in formal methods and cybersecurity verification Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom The candidate must have a sound knowledge of formal methods, transition systems, verification algorithms and software development. They must be able to design, test and document research software in a collaborative environment, and have a good command of English. Skills in temporal or strategic logic, model checking, symbolic methods, SAT/SMT and multi-agent systems would be an advantage. Experience in cybersecurity, attack graphs, Python/C++ programming, Docker or distributed systems would also be an asset. The candidate must demonstrate good team spirit, rigour, organisational skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as strong communication and technical writing skills. Education and experience : Master’s degree (Bac+5) or equivalent; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+4) with at least 4 years’ experience; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+3) with 6 years’ experience; or a two-year higher education qualification (Bac+2) with 10 years’ professional experience. Why join us? You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from : 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT) flexible working hours (depending on department activity) telecommuting 1 to 3 days/week possible 75% public transport pass reimbursement Proximity to numerous sports facilities, concierge service, underground parking, in-house catering, etc. Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector Remuneration details: Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. About Liftoff Security Team The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. As our Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you will own internal offensive testing and lead the move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous, AI-assisted testing. You will independently plan assessments, safely validate vulnerabilities, work with engineering teams through remediation and retesting, and build sustained knowledge of our source code and systems. You will contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security, support Accelerate and MX as priorities change, and share the team's on-call and incident-response work. Responsibilities Independently plan and execute internal penetration tests across applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems; prioritize assessments by risk and business impact. Define testing scope and rules of engagement with system owners, assess production risk, and choose safe methods for validating vulnerabilities. Combine hands-on testing with source-code review and architectural analysis to find vulnerabilities and demonstrate realistic attack paths. Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, agree on practical fixes, track remediation, and retest to confirm the risk is resolved. Maintain knowledge of Liftoff’s systems and attack surface, revisit high-risk attack paths as systems change, and turn confirmed findings into repeatable tests. Build testing tools and workflows that combine hands-on assessments with ongoing automated testing and remediation validation. Make security testing self-service where practical through reusable tests, documented assessment and retesting workflows, and clear remediation guidance. Support the annual third-party penetration test for independent validation and customer and audit requirements; coordinate scope and follow findings through remediation. Lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tooling: evaluate platforms and build workflows for code analysis, test generation, and finding triage; measure coverage, accuracy, and effort saved. Partner with Detection & Response to turn validated attack paths and offensive findings into detection improvements and incident-response exercises. Work across application, cloud, and infrastructure security as priorities change, including Accelerate and MX, and share the team’s on-call and incident-response rotation, including occasional off-hours response and post-incident follow-up. Minimum qualifications 5+ years of relevant security engineering experience, including substantial hands-on penetration testing of applications and infrastructure. Excellent judgment in prioritizing testing by risk, assessing production impact, and safely validating exploits without unnecessary disruption. Experience independently owning assessments and partnering with engineering teams from initial findings through remediation and retesting. Write production-quality code for security tools and automation, review pull requests, and navigate large, unfamiliar codebases. Develop safe proof-of-concept code and independently validate AI-generated code and findings. Strong understanding of application and API security, authentication and authorization, network security, and common vulnerability classes. Hands-on experience assessing cloud and infrastructure security, including identity and access controls, configuration, and attack paths. Ability to quickly understand complex systems and architecture and contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security. Practical software engineering habits: testing, observability, version control, peer code review, continuous integration, and blameless postmortems. Strong technical writing: clear assessment plans, proposals, reproducible findings, runbooks, and post-incident reviews that support engineering decisions. Explain exploitability and business impact clearly in writing and conversation. Willingness to share the security team’s on-call and incident-response responsibilities, including occasional off-hours response. Desirable qualifications Experience with Go, Python, Clojure, or JavaScript; ability to work across languages matters more than a specific language. Experience building AI-assisted security testing workflows and measuring the accuracy and usefulness of their results. Experience securing large-scale cloud systems, mobile advertising, or other high-volume SaaS environments. Why This Role is Exciting Ownership & Impact : Build and own our in-house offensive security capability, from selecting assessments to confirming fixes. Broad Attack Surface : Test applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems with access to source code and engineering context. Engineering Partnership : Work with teams that value security and stay involved through remediation and retesting. Room to Grow : Move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous testing and lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tools. Hands-On Technical Work: Investigate complex systems, validate vulnerabilities safely, and build tools that make testing more effective. title: Senioringeniør – Identity, Credential and Access Management (ICAM)
description: Vil du være med på å sikre og videreutvikle en av Norges mest kritiske løsninger for identitet, autentisering og credentials? Cyberforsvaret er ansvarlig for å drifte, vedlikeholde og beskytte Forsvarets samband og informasjonsinfrastruktur. Cyberforsvarets IT-avdeling (CIT) har ansvaret for utvikling, drift og vedlikehold av Forsvarets IT-systemer.For ytterligere informasjon om Cyberforsvaret og Forsvaret generelt, se  www.forsvaret.no Vi har ledig en fast stilling som senior systemingeniør ICAM (Identity, Credential and Access Management). I rollen vil du jobbe hands-on med å utvikle, automatisere og drifte Forsvarets ICAM‑tjenester, med særlig fokus på håndtering av credentials som sertifikater, nøkler og autentisering. Rollen er sentral i å sikre identitet, autentisering og tilgang i en virksomhet med høye krav til sikkerhet og tilgjengelighet. Du vil bli en del av seksjonen Sikkerhetsløsning i CIT, et fagmiljø som bidrar til å sikre Forsvarets leveranseevne nasjonalt og internasjonalt. Seksjonen har ansvar for utvikling, drift og videreutvikling av flere tjenester innen cybersikkerhet, med særlig fokus på høy tilgjengelighet og sikkerhet uavhengig av beredskapsnivå. Du vil inngå i et DevSecOps-team med ansvar for stabile, sikre og etterprøvbare tjenester. Arbeidet omfatter utvikling og videreutvikling av løsninger for PKI og autentisering, inkludert MFA og 2FA, som en del av en sikkerhetstilnærming basert på Zero Trust-prinsipper, hvor kontinuerlig verifisering av identiteter, enheter og credentials er grunnleggende for tilgang. I rollen vil du arbeide operativt med PKI som en del av teamets samlede ansvar. Dette inkluderer implementering og drift av sertifikattjenester (CA), håndtering av sertifikatlivssyklus, nøkkelbeskyttelse og etablering av robuste tillitskjeder. Du vil også bidra til automatisering av sertifikatutstedelse og -fornyelse, samt håndtering av tilbakekalling og validering av sertifikater gjennom både listebaserte (CRL) og sanntidsbaserte (OCSP) mekanismer. Arbeidet omfatter bruk av hardware-baserte sikkerhetsmoduler (HSM) og integrasjon av PKI i autentisering, signering, kryptering og enhetstillit. Vi ser etter deg som trives med å jobbe tett på teknologi og løsninger, og som evner å omsette behov til robuste og fungerende tekniske løsninger. Du vil bidra til etablering og videreutvikling av rollemodeller, policyer og automatiserte arbeidsflyter, samtidig som du er tett på drift, feilsøking og kontinuerlig forbedring av ICAM‑tjenestene. For kandidater med relevant bakgrunn og interesse kan det være aktuelt å bidra i fag- og arbeidsgrupper i NATO knyttet til ICAM, PKI og Zero Trust. Arbeidssted er Kolsås. Arbeidsoppgaver Utvikle, automatisere og drifte ICAM-tjenester i tråd med virksomhetens behov, arkitektur og sikkerhetskrav Bidra til credential-håndtering gjennom etablering og videreutvikling av løsninger for sertifikater, nøkler og autentisering, samt rollemodeller, policyer og integrasjoner mot interne og eksterne systemer Arbeide operativt med PKI, inkludert design og drift av CA-strukturer (root og mellomliggende), sertifikatlivssyklus og nøkkelhåndterin. Automatisere utstedelse, fornyelse og tilbakekalling av sertifikater, inkludert bruk av listebasert (CRL) og sanntidsbasert (OCSP) validering av sertifikatstatus Sikre etterlevelse av sikkerhetskrav, regelverk og datakvalitet gjennom løpende kontroller, vedlikehold av tilgangsmodeller og forbedringer av styringsmekanismer Vedlikeholde dokumentasjon, rutiner og operasjonelle prosedyrer, samt bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring basert på driftserfaring og revisjonsfunn Kvalifikasjoner Master innen relevant fagområde (IKT) Annen utdanning, sertifiseringer og/eller relevant erfaring kan etter vurdering kompensere for manglende formell utdanning. Med relevant erfaring menes at to års relevant erfaring vil kunne kompensere for ett års manglende formell utdanning innen fagområdet Minimum 5 års arbeidserfaring fra relevant fagområde (IKT) God norsk muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne Den som ansettes må kunne sikkerhetsklareres for STRENGT HEMMELIG  og COSMIC TOP SECRET før tiltredelse (for mer informasjon om sikkerhetsklarering se   www.nsm.no ) Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner: God kjennskap til Forsvaret Grunnleggende forståelse av ITIL og smidige arbeidsprosesser Erfaring innenfor utvikling, drift eller vedlikehold av IT-miljøer innen avdelingens fagområder, eller dokumentert kunnskap i form av sertifiseringer og/eller kurs innenfor disse fagområdene Erfaring med IAM-teknologi Erfaring med innføring av IAM i store virksomheter Erfaring med Kubernetes og kontainere Erfaring med skripting og automatisering  Vi ber deg svare ut alle kvalifikasjonskravene listet over i din søknad, og gjør oppmerksom på at du må oppfylle alle MÅ-kravene for å være aktuell for stillingen.  Attester og vitnemål må legges ved søknaden. Forsvarets viktigste oppgave er å skape sikkerhet for Norge og trygghet for befolkningen. Uansett hvilken stilling du har, er du med på å ivareta landets og fellesskapets interesser. title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Security Team Examples of key problems the team is working on You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door. Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents. Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small. Role Scope Lead incident response end to end across corporate, cloud, and data center environments, from detection and containment through eradication and post-incident review. Build the detection logic, response playbooks, and forensic tooling for an environment where the assets under threat are the most targeted model weights in technology. Run investigations across a threat surface measured in gigawatts, correlating signals from cloud, endpoint, network, and physical systems into a single picture of an attack. Stand up the incident response function from the ground up, defining severity models, on-call rotations, and the escalation path to leadership. description: At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary We are looking for a Global Support Engineer I who can support a remote-first, flexible shift schedule. This is a growth role—you will advance your career as a support engineering professional while simultaneously increasing your knowledge and hands-on experience with networking infrastructure as a service. You will regularly support interesting and challenging technical matters and questions and bring clarity to our customers as they leverage our tools to secure their networks in an ever-changing security threat landscape. Key Responsibilities As a member of the Global Support Engineering team, you will work with customers to resolve technical issues with our product(s) using a variety of internal resources and provide data analysis to understand and troubleshoot systems. Your day-to-day responsibilities could include any of the following: Provide hardware and firmware deployment support for our appliances. Actively participate in Knowledge Centered Services (KCS) by learning from documented knowledge and contributing to discussions. Engage in troubleshooting activities, following guidance and existing documentation. Assist with the initial stages of ticket handling and escalate when necessary. Work collaboratively with more experienced engineers and cross functional teams to gain deeper insights into complex issues. Assist customers with configuration of network infrastructure, virtualization, and third-party integrations. Assist customers with hardware support and replacement. Utilize a ticketing system to update, communicate, and move work items to completion. Act as the single point of contact for customer questions and concerns. Communicate with customers in a highly professional manner via various channels including phone, ticketing system, and video conferencing. Pair your existing knowledge with a continuous learning mindset to elevate your service to our customers while being a force-multiplier to your colleagues. Attend regular “in-office” meetings (limited to no more than monthly) and annual in-office training sessions Required Qualifications Two years of experience in B2B Technical Support — this is not an entry-level position. In-depth knowledge of the OSI model. Understanding of network infrastructure routing and switching concepts. In-depth knowledge of data traversal within an internal environment and its interaction with external networks. Specific networking knowledge related to protocols, DHCP, TCP, DNS resolution, TLS and TLS connection establishment, HTTP, SSO, network topologies, etc. Ability to translate technical concepts into applicable troubleshooting best practices. Ability to troubleshoot complex architectural incidents based on the application or incident. Excellent customer service, organizational, and documentation skills. Ability to work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to work well in fast-paced, high-stress environments. title: Software Engineer, Engineering Acceleration
description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What We're Looking For We're looking for software engineers to join Engineering Acceleration, one of the teams in Omnea's Platform Engineering department, building the tools and infrastructure that help Omnea's engineers develop, test and ship software. Engineering Acceleration develops and operates the systems that support AI-assisted software development: agent tooling, context management, development environments and automated validation. You'll work across application code and infrastructure, improving existing systems and building new capabilities. You'll likely come from product or backend engineering, though developer tooling experience is a plus. What matters is strong software engineering ability, practical infrastructure experience and an interest in making other engineers more effective. What You'll Do Build systems for AI-native software engineering. Develop the tooling and infrastructure that enable engineers to delegate substantial engineering work to agents, spanning investigation, implementation, testing and code review. Improve the context, execution environments and feedback available to agents so they can complete increasingly complex tasks reliably. Improve development and testing environments. Develop the infrastructure that allows engineers and agents to reproduce problems, run applications and verify changes. Improve development environments, previews and automated validation. Evaluate quality and impact. Build evaluations for agent behaviour and test changes to context, tools and configuration against representative engineering tasks. Measure the effect on correctness, review effort, reliability and cost before wider rollout. Identify and address engineering bottlenecks. Work with engineers across Omnea to identify friction in development, testing and delivery. Prioritise improvements based on their impact on engineering productivity and software quality, and measure the results. Lead tooling selection and adoption. Assess emerging tools and make build-versus-buy decisions based on capability, integration effort and long-term maintenance. Spearhead the selection and rollout of an agentic development platform (ADP), giving engineers a single interface for tooling and agent management. Own systems through delivery and operation. Take responsibility for technical design, implementation, deployment and ongoing operation. Build for reliability and maintainability, with appropriate observability, access controls and recovery mechanisms. What Can You Expect? Join the team early. Help shape and invent how engineers and agents design, build and verify software at Omnea. You'll be an integral part of deciding the team's technical direction, develop new approaches and own projects from experimentation through to adoption across engineering. Work directly with your users. You'll collaborate with Product engineers and the other Platform Engineering teams to understand their requirements and evaluate the impact of your work. Work across the stack. Our stack includes TypeScript, React, Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure, with SST, Pulumi, GitHub Actions and Datadog. About You Strong software engineering fundamentals. You have experience designing, shipping and operating production software. You bring sound judgement to system design, testing and reliability, and can diagnose failures across application and infrastructure boundaries. Practical AWS serverless experience. You've built or maintained serverless infrastructure on AWS, deployment pipelines or development environments. You understand the trade-offs around access control, isolation, observability, reliability and cost. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development. You've applied coding agents to software development and understand their capabilities and failure modes. You have practical experience with the context, tools and verification needed to use them effectively. Product engineering background. You've worked as a product engineer shipping user-facing features, and you bring that mindset to internal tooling. You can translate developer needs into well-designed tools and services. You evaluate success through adoption, user feedback and measurable improvements to the development process. Independent execution. You can scope ambiguous technical problems, assess alternatives and deliver projects without a detailed specification. You make considered trade-offs between delivery speed, reliability and long-term maintenance. Effective collaboration. You communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, work constructively across team boundaries and incorporate feedback into your approach. You share knowledge and contribute to the engineering practices of the wider team. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). title: Customer Success Engineer, Australia
description: At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary At ExtraHop, we're on a mission to help organizations achieve complete visibility, real-time threat detection, and proactive security through cutting-edge network detection and response (NDR) technology. Our NDR product is a market leader, providing our customers with the ability to detect, investigate, and respond to threats faster than ever before. We’re proud of the work we do and the recognition we’ve received, including our recent Gartner Peer Insights award, which reflects the trust and satisfaction our customers have in our solutions. If you're passionate about innovation, dedicated to protecting digital infrastructures, and ready to make a real impact, we invite you to join our team and help us shape the future of cybersecurity. Do you want to work with a platform and technology where you can help customers solve critical business problems? Do you enjoy and excel at building lasting customer relationships? As a member of our Customer Success team, you’ll have the opportunity to unleash your expertise to wow customers and make a difference in an exciting, growing company. At ExtraHop, we provide solutions for mission-critical business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. With us, you’ll deliver solutions that customers previously thought infeasible or impossible to solve. Join us and you’ll find we have a supportive home team, great customers, and a product that customers love. Key Responsibilities The ExtraHop Customer Success team focuses on successful outcomes for our customers. As a Technical Customer Success Manager, you will play a leading role in accomplishing the following goals: Analyze customer requirements and promote the highest value application of ExtraHop in our customer's business environment. Secure contract renewals and identify growth opportunities by assisting customers in driving successful outcomes with ExtraHop products and services. Engage ExtraHop end-users to provide targeted assistance and enablement - both FTF and remote customers. Assist in assessing customer needs and coordinate high-value services such as ExtraHop Professional Services and advanced training. Lead and facilitate new customer’s initial onboarding and introduction to ExtraHop. Assess and document customer health and maturity levels to improve customer engagement strategy. Execute direct customer engagement workflows and automated processes to evangelize ExtraHop and engage a wide cross-section of our user community. Partner closely with the local account team to align customer strategic goals with technical execution, driving continuous product adoption and account expansion. Assist and contribute to ExtraHop’s Voice of Customer activities and provide influential input on product and service roadmap priorities. Work with a diverse cross-section of ExtraHop’s business units and represent customer needs and expectations. Champion customer needs and opportunities for product enhancement with ExtraHop development teams. Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans documenting customer’s desired outcomes and value expectations. Promote customers' use of our community platform and self-service capabilities. Develop deep customer relationships across the customer organizations with key stakeholders and technology leaders. Recognize organic opportunities for expansion/growth and engage the Sales team to pursue. Host and conduct recurring customer meetings, working sessions, and Business Reviews with customers. Operate as the nexus for customer engagement and strategy with other ExtraHop teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Support. Delivers hybrid customer engagement through a balanced mix of remote collaboration and in-person meetings, with occasional travel as required. Required Qualifications We’re looking for a seasoned Customer Success Manager who can help us grow to the next level as a company. As a starting point for this position, you’ll need the following background: Four-year college degree, preferably in a technical field such as management information systems or information technology. Skills and Competencies Work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to work flexibly, both with independent initiative and judgment as well as execute established Customer Success programs consistently and accurately. Proficiency of networking principles (layers 2 through 4 of the OSI model) and application protocols (e.g., HTTP, CIFS,, DB Protocols such as TNS/TDS, MS-RPC, and DNS). Technical proficiency in enterprise networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing/switching, network packet brokers, firewalls) and API integrations for security stack interoperability. Experience with enterprise security operations, including Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows and Incident Response (IR) protocols. Hands-on familiarity with firewalls, SIEM/SOAR integrations, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR), Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIP), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and architectures. Experience in major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, and containerization concepts. Experience with project management is a plus. Proficient user of Salesforce.com CRM or similar. Intermediate-level skills with Microsoft Excel, familiar with formulas and basic data manipulation & analysis. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. OUR VALUES Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. BENEFITS Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. title: Vil du jobbe med drift av Forsvarets PKI-løsning?
description: Vil du bli en del av Norges råeste arbeidsplass for teknologer? Cyberforsvaret er ansvarlig for å drifte, vedlikeholde og beskytte Forsvarets samband og informasjonsinfrastruktur. Cyberforsvarets IT-avdeling (CIT) har ansvaret for utvikling, drift og vedlikehold av Forsvarets IT-systemer.For ytterligere informasjon om Cyberforsvaret og Forsvaret generelt, se  www.forsvaret.no Vi har ledig en fast stilling som Senior systemingeniør FPKI (Forsvarets Public Key Infrastructure). I denne stillingen blir du en del av et DevSecOps-team som har medansvar for å utvikle, automatisere og drifte FPKI-løsningen, slik at sertifikathåndtering fungerer stabilt, sikkert og etterprøvbart i virksomheten. Hvis du liker å jobbe agilt, brenner for cybersikkerhet og har erfaring eller interesse for PKI og identitets- og sikkerhetsteknologi, oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Som vår nye kollega blir du del av seksjon Sikkerhetsløsning i CIT, et miljø med dedikerte fagfolk som hver dag bidrar til å sikre Forsvarets leveranseevne nasjonalt og internasjonalt. Seksjonen har ansvaret for utvikling, drift og vedlikehold av flere produkter innenfor cybersikkerhet. Vårt fokus er på tilgjengelighet og sikkerhet på tjenestene uansett beredskapsnivå. Arbeidssted er Kolsås. Arbeidsoppgaver Utvikle, automatisere og videreutvikle PKI-løsningen for sertifikatsyklus, inkludert vedlikehold av policyer, profiler og integrasjoner mot plattformer og applikasjoner Sikre stabil og sikker drift av PKI-tjenesten gjennom kontinuerlig overvåking, feilretting og vedlikehold av sertifikatutstedelse, fornyelse og tilbakekalling Planlegge og gjennomføre oppgraderinger og endringer i PKI-infrastruktur for å håndtere sårbarheter, kryptografiske krav og teknisk gjeld over tid Sikre etterlevelse av sikkerhetskrav, kryptografiske standarder og interne retningslinjer gjennom regelmessig kontroller og vedlikehold av konfigurasjon og nøkkelhåndtering Vedlikeholde teknisk dokumentasjon, prosedyrer og beredskapsplaner, samt forbedre løsningen basert på hendelser, revisjoner og modenhetsbehov Kvalifikasjoner Bachelor innen relevant fagområde (IKT) Annen utdanning, sertifiseringer og/eller relevant erfaring kan etter vurdering kompensere for manglende formell utdanning. Med relevant erfaring menes at to års relevant erfaring vil kunne kompensere for ett års manglende formell utdanning innen fagområdet. Min. 3 års erfaring fra relevant fagområde (IKT) God norsk muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne Må kunne sikkerhetsklareres for STRENGT HEMMELIG  og COSMIC TOP SECRET før tiltredelse (for mer informasjon om sikkerhetsklarering se   www.nsm.no ) Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner: Master innen relevant fagområde (IKT) God kjennskap til Forsvaret Grunnleggende forståelse av ITIL og smidige arbeidsprosesser Erfaring innenfor utvikling, drift eller vedlikehold av IT-miljøer innen avdelingens fagområder Dokumentert kunnskap i form av sertifiseringer og/eller kurs innenfor avdelingens fagområder Erfaring med feilsøking og support på IKT-plattformer Erfaring med skripting og automatisering  En oppdatert og detaljert CV som beskriver relevant utdanning, arbeidserfaring, ansvarsområder og oppnådde resultater gir oss et best mulig grunnlag for å vurdere din kompetanse opp mot stillingen.  Attester, vitnemål og annen relevant dokumentasjon må legges ved søknaden. Høyere utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning/NOKUT. Godkjenning må dokumenteres. Personlige egenskaper Vår nye kollega er nøyaktig og strukturert Du har god vurderingsevne Evne til å ha helhetsoversikt og fullføre oppgaver Gode samarbeidsevner Du er en aktiv bidragsyter til et godt arbeidsmiljø Jobber godt både selvstendig og i team Vi legger stor vekt på motivasjon og personlige egenskaper for stillingen Vi tilbyr Jobb i et av Norges fremste og største militærteknologiske fagmiljø Fleksibel arbeidstid Bedriftshelsetjeneste Mulighet til å trene inntil 2 timer per uke i arbeidstiden. På Kolsås har du tilgang til svømmehall og styrkerom. Mulighet til å søke om barnehageplass i vår egen barnehage Parkeringsmuligheter og gangavstand til Kolsås T-banestasjon Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode låne-, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger ( http://spk.no ) Du vil få lønn som overingeniør stillingskode 1087 kr 680 000  - kr 880 000 per år, avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. For spesielt godt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. Av lønnen trekkes 2% lovbestemt innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.  KontaktinformasjonEngødegård, Erik Haug, Seniorrådgiver, +47 951 46 027 ArbeidsstedRødskiferveien 20 1352 Kolsås Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Forsvaret Referansenr.: 5186319337 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 02.11.2026 Om arbeidsgiveren: En jobb i Forsvaret er noe mer enn en jobb. Forsvarets viktigste oppgave er å skape sikkerhet for Norge og trygghet for befolkningen. Uansett hvilken stilling du har, er du med på å ivareta landets og fellesskapets interesser. For å verne om alt vi har og alt vi er, må vi selv leve ut de verdiene vi er satt til å forsvare. Vi ønsker derfor ansatte som bidrar til en god kultur ved å vise respekt og ta ansvar for hverandre, og ha mot til å handle riktig og våge å si ifra. Som en del av Cyberforsvaret er du med på å drifte, sikre og forsvare Forsvarets datasystemer, nettverk og høyteknologiske plattformer mot angrep i og fra cyberdomenet. I Forsvaret er det ønskelig at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, kulturell bakgrunn, hull i CV-en eller funksjonsevne. Vi vil sørge for tilrettelegging på arbeidsplassen hvis det er behov for dette. Noen av Forsvarets stillinger kan ha egne helsekrav og krav til fysisk skikkethet. I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25 andre ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Det er egne regler for militære stillinger. Forsvaret benytter elektronisk søknadsbehandling. Attester og vitnemål må legges ved søknaden. Høyere utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være offentlig godkjent av NOKUT eller Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse . Godkjenningen må dokumenteres. Det blir gjennomført bakgrunnsjekk når sikkerhetsklareringen gjennomføres. Les mer om jobb i Forsvaret.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany or Hungary
description: About Linro Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it. We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape. The role You would be the engineer who gets Linro running inside a customer's real environment and keeps it running. Our founders and go-to-market team win the customer and own the commercial relationship. You own the technical side: you take a customer from signed agreement to a working install and the first blocked change, and stay on it after go-live for upgrades, incidents and tuning. Part of this happens on-site: you may spend a few days at a customer's office to get an install running or to work through a problem with their team. Everything you learn goes back to engineering and product. This is an engineering role, not a support or sales role, and there is no quota. What you will do Run customer onboarding end to end: connect the customer's cloud accounts, whichever provider they run on, deploy sensors (managed, or inside the customer's own cluster) and get to a first blocked change fast. Write and tune SQL-based policies and policy packs mapped to each customer's frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA), and keep false positives low. Wire Linro guardrails into the customer's Terraform and CI/CD workflows and into their AI coding agents through MCP. Run Linro in production at the customer: monitor, upgrade and respond when it breaks. Debug inside their environment, hand reproducible findings to engineering, and fix what you can yourself. Close the loop: structured feedback to product and engineering, reusable playbooks for the next customer, and a seat in scoping calls so that what we promise is what installs. What we are looking for 5 to 6+ years of customer-facing technical delivery (forward deployed or solutions engineering, SRE or platform consulting), deploying infrastructure or security software in customer environments and keeping it running afterwards. Hands-on cloud experience: you have run real workloads, identity and access, networking and audit logging on at least one major cloud, and you pick up the others quickly. You are a solid engineer. You write real code in Go or Python for integrations and tooling, read Go services, and are comfortable with SQL and APIs. You use AI coding agents daily, such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and have hands-on MCP experience. You understand how companies work: change management, approvals, release and audit processes, and how to fit Linro into them. Restricted-network experience: proxies, private networking, data residency, self-hosted or in-cluster installs. Communication and comfort with ambiguity. You explain trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives, set honest expectations, and keep making progress when requirements are still unclear. Fluent English. Open to travel. To customers across Europe and the US, up to roughly a quarter of your time. Nice to have Turning compliance frameworks (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) into concrete controls. Policy-as-code (OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Cedar) or CSPM tooling. How we work We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time. What we offer Real ownership. You own every customer deployment from day one, with direct access to the founders and to the engineers who built what you are deploying. Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market. A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other's time seriously. The honest version This is early. You will often be the first person to run Linro in a customer's environment, and you will write the playbooks as you go. If you want a polished onboarding process and a stable product surface, this is not it. If you want to sit between a new category and the customers who need it, and you like the idea of deploying the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk. title: Technical Solutions Engineer
description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast. The job shifts with it. Instead of grinding through every stack trace yourself, you direct AI to accelerate the investigation and apply what AI can't: judgment on whether a fix is safe to ship into a live enterprise environment, whether the root cause is actually fixed or just patched, and whether this is a one-off or a pattern worth escalating to Product. As Omnea's Technical Solutions Engineer, you're the senior technical presence sitting between Customer, Product, and Engineering. You own Omnea's most complex customer-facing technical problems end to end - gnarly integrations, cross-system issues, escalations nobody else can crack. You're the person the team calls in when something's on fire, and you're just as comfortable stepping into a customer's implementation when it gets technical. This is a foundational hire. You'll set the technical bar for how Omnea supports enterprise customers, and help define how the function grows from here. What You'll Do Own the hardest technical problems: Lead investigation and resolution of Omnea's most complex customer issues - integrations, configuration edge cases, cross-system bugs. Direct AI to accelerate the first pass, then apply the judgment AI can't: is this safe to ship, is the root cause actually fixed. Be the SWAT team between Customer, Product, and Engineering: Act as the senior escalation point when an issue is beyond what the Customer team can resolve alone, and the technical voice in the room when Product and Engineering need to understand what's really happening on the ground. Get technical inside implementations: Step into live implementations when they hit technical complexity - tricky integrations, custom logic, unusual data flows - and work directly with the implementation team to get them unstuck. Feed the product roadmap: Spot patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-scoped input for Product and Engineering, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice. Build the standards as you go: Document what you learn, build the tooling and playbooks for triaging and resolving complex technical issues, and raise the bar for technical quality as the team grows around you. What's Different About This Role You'll spend more time directing AI through the first pass of an investigation than manually tracing every log line yourself. AI narrows down the likely cause fast; your job is confirming it's right and safe to act on. Writing a sharp, specific brief for what you want AI to investigate or fix is now a core skill, not a nice-to-have. Judgment on production risk matters more, not less: AI can suggest a fix in minutes, but you decide whether it's safe for a live enterprise environment. You'll keep experimenting with AI tooling as it evolves, and bring what works back to the rest of the team. About You We don't expect you to have done this exact job before. TL;DR: you're a technical, customer-facing problem-solver who's as comfortable elbow-deep in an API integration as you are explaining what went wrong to a CFO's technical lead. 3-8+ years in a customer-facing technical role - technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or similar - at a fast-growing SaaS company A technical background: a Computer Science or Engineering degree, prior experience as a software developer or engineer, or strong hands-on experience with SQL, APIs, and system integrations Strong systems intuition: comfortable diving into unfamiliar platforms, reasoning about architecture, and figuring out where in a complex system something's actually broken Comfortable directing AI tools to speed up investigation and first-draft fixes, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check An excellent communicator who can flex between a technical deep-dive with an engineer and a clear explanation for a non-technical stakeholder Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity: you want to help build the standards and playbook for this function, not just follow one that already exists High ownership: when something's broken, you own it through to resolution, and you raise your hand for the hard problems rather than waiting to be assigned them At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up. 🧠 Your day-to-day As a Test Engineer, you'll independently own the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack. You'll build robust, reusable test automation, drive failures to root cause across engineering boundaries, and steadily raise the bar on coverage, reliability, and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system including sensing and model-behaviour testing as the company and your experience evolve. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement across multiple engineering domains. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration, and system levels, across software and hardware boundaries. Automate open-loop and closed-loop replay based Tests, reliability and fault-injection tests to support verification, release, coverage expansion, and debug workflows. Lead root-cause investigations for failures found during test campaigns, collaborating across hardware, software, and infrastructure teams. Optimise buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable, and repeatable execution. Integrate third-party verification tools including JAMA (requirements), MC/DC (coverage), and MISRA (style compliance); manage artefacts via Artifactory and Azure. Define and track KPIs and quality metrics for system testing, supporting data-driven validation and release decisions. Uncover software and hardware bugs through increased test coverage and report findings through JIRA. Identify and implement infrastructure improvements that enhance test coverage, failure traceability, and compliance reporting. Review, create, and adhere to Risk Assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly. 🙌 You should apply if Essential Skills & Experience Hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software, or mechatronic systems, with a track record of delivering test automation independently. Experience with L2+ hands-off, L3, or L4 automated driving systems. Knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols (e.g., Euro NCAP -AEB, LSS/LKA, ADAS scenarios), DCAS regulatory testing (UN R171), and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155). Experience with HiL testing and tooling using CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, dSPACE, Vector, Xylon, or similar. Strong proficiency in Python, including developing automation test frameworks with pytest. Proven ability in interface-level testing, including hardware/software interactions and embedded interfaces. Experience integrating software quality assurance tools and standards (ASPICE, SOTIF, ISO 26262, JAMA, X-RAY). Knowledge of open- and closed-loop HiL replay using dSPACE or other emulators. Proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling (e.g., GitLab CI, Buildkite, Bazel). Experience with test automation dashboards, logging, and reporting infrastructure (e.g., Grafana, Looker, Datadog, JIRA). Experience developing or testing automotive software across embedded and system levels. Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work collaboratively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps, and product teams. Desirable Skills & Experience Experience with autonomous vehicle systems, ADAS, or related technologies.. Strong Python Automation and knowledge of dSPACE open and closed Loop HIL based replay Testing Experience contributing to continuous improvement of test methods, safety procedures, or operational efficiency. Awareness of data management and version control systems (e.g., Git, Buildkite, or similar). Familiarity with agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and a demonstrated ability to use them to accelerate and optimise test development, debugging, and automation workflows. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews [Python Programming, 60mins] Deep-dive technical interviews [System Design, Validation & Release, 60mins, Cross Functional Collaboration, 60mins] Final interview : [Mission & Values alignment, 30mins]. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
