title: Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) Officer
description: At MindWave, we’re not just building teams. We’re building a new way of working. We’re creating a community of experts who thrive in a transparent, human, and forward-thinking environment. We are currently looking for a Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) Officer to join our community and support a major CISO Cybersecurity Center of Excellence team. In this role, you will contribute to daily security incident preparation, detection, and response activities—including threat detection, level 3/4 incident handling, forensic analysis, threat hunting, and SIEM engineering—while working closely with internal staff, affiliates, and external security service providers. Key Responsibilities 1. Incident Handling & Level 3/4 Response Investigate and respond adequately to Level 3/4 security incidents, including malware infections, network intrusions, and data breaches across IT, IoT, and OT environments. Conduct forensic investigations, technical coordination, and deep-dive analysis of security incidents regardless of origin. Work closely with SOC, CSIRT, and cross-functional internal teams to identify, mitigate, and remediate security risks. Develop, refine, and implement incident response plans and procedures, providing guidance on security best practices across the organization. Clearly communicate and report security incident progress, risks, and post-incident analysis to internal and external stakeholders. 2. Threat Detection & Threat Hunting Proactively identify threats and vulnerabilities across the organization's infrastructure using SIEM platforms and custom detection tools. Conduct regular threat hunting exercises to detect potential threats that have evaded traditional security controls. Collect and analyze security data and system artifacts (analyzing Windows, Linux, network, and security logs) to identify anomalous behavior and indicators of compromise (IOCs). Collaborate closely with the 3rd party SOC team to investigate potential security incidents and provide technical guidance on threat remediation and mitigation strategies. 3. SIEM Engineering & Automation Develop, maintain, and optimize SIEM systems (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel) to ensure timely detection and rapid incident response. Create, refine, and maintain custom detection rules and use cases aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework. Author and maintain detailed playbooks for the SOC team to ensure standardized, consistent, and effective incident response. Automate alert handling and response workflows for SIEM and EDR events to streamline security operations and allow the SOC/CSIRT to focus on high-priority threats. 4. Projects, Exercises & Continuous Improvement Organize, animate, and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test organizational incident response readiness. Contribute to security engineering projects based on team needs, such as deploying, maintaining, and integrating new security platforms or tools. Script and automate manual operational tasks to enhance the team's efficiency and detection capabilities. Team Context You will join the CISO Cybersecurity Center of Excellence team within the enterprise CISO organization. You are adaptable and creative: you adjust your method to each type of company and deal instead of copy-pasting one process. description: This is NTNU NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU has a vacancy for a PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks. As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a range of leading positions in business, administration, higher education and research. The position is fully funded and will run for 4 years (100 % employment), including teaching duties. Your immediate leader will be the Head of Discipline, and the workplace will be in Trondheim. About the project Mobile networks increasingly support critical services in emergency response, industry, transport, and maritime operations. Access to several networks can improve resilience, but sustaining a service requires more than restoring connectivity. Independently operated networks must coordinate resources and priorities while managing dependencies and commitments to existing users. They may also depend on shared infrastructure or capacity leased from one another, limiting the resilience gained from access to multiple operators. Norway’s plans for a new emergency network (Nødnett) over commercial mobile infrastructure illustrate the relevance of these broader challenges. As a PhD candidate, you will investigate how mobile networks can cooperate to maintain critical services during failures, congestion, and recovery. Your research will address networks that retain their own operational policies and exchange limited information about capacity and internal state, developing insights applicable across public and private networks. A specific focus will be on the networked systems mechanisms, data paths, and open interfaces needed to support resilient service continuity in multi-operator mobile network systems, addressing research questions such as: What information must networks exchange to make effective admission and resource-allocation decisions without requiring full visibility into each other’s infrastructure? How can service priorities and resource policies be coordinated across heterogeneous networks, including during congestion and large bursts of registration requests? How can network selection, traffic steering, and recovery mechanisms maintain application continuity while avoiding repeated switching and overload cascades? How do shared infrastructure, leased capacity, and dependencies between operators affect failure propagation and the resilience gained from alternative network access? With the  Beyond 5G lab at the department, the project will emphasize experimental systems research: you will have the opportunity to conduct your research in both commercial and open-source mobile network deployments and test your ideas under realistic conditions. To explore conditions beyond the scale of the physical deployments, methods including simulation and analytical modeling can be a complementary building block. Duties of the position Complete doctoral education and obtain a doctorate Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above Academic publications and popular science dissemination Participate in the  Networking research group Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions Teaching in courses related to networking Other career-enhancing work Some changes to your work duties may occur after employment. Required selection criteria You must meet the requirements for admission to the  faculty's Doctoral Programme in Information Security and Communication Technology , see  Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information. You must have a relevant master's degree in communication networks, wireless and mobile communications, information security and distributed systems, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and preferably within August 2027. You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to  NTNU's grading scale . If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works. If you are in your master’s program, integrated PhD could be an option. Your MSc grades after your fourth year need to be completed with a grade B or better, in addition the IE-faculty require that your bachelor degree is completed with a grade C or better. Integrated PhD - Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering - NTNU . Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English. The appointment is to be made in accordance with  NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position. Preferred selection criteria Practical experience with 5G radio access and core deployments. Hands-on experience with communication networks including multi-vendor and softwarized environments. Exposure to resilience and dependability topics in the context of communication networks as part of the master’s curriculum. Teaching experience, preferably at master’s level. Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Personal characteristics To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are Highly motivated by fundamental scientific research with practical relevance. Able to work independently. Able to work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them. Eager to disseminate research results both locally as well as through publications and presentations at international conferences. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.  We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.  If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time. title: Applied AI Engineer - Operations
description: Action1 is an autonomous patch management platform trusted by many Fortune 500 companies. Cloud-native, infinitely scalable, highly secure, and configurable in 5 minutes, it just works and is always free for the first 200 endpoints, with no functional limits. By pioneering autonomous OS and third-party application patching, Action1 helps organizations eliminate routine work, reduce ransomware and security risks, and protect the digital employee experience. It provides real-time vulnerability assessment and remediation across remote and on-site endpoints without requiring a VPN, while peer-to-peer patch distribution reduces bandwidth use on local networks. In 2026, Action1 was recognized as the fastest-growing founder-led cybersecurity company in America on the Inc. 5000. Action1 is led by industry veterans Alex Vovk and Mike Walters, American entrepreneurs who founded Netwrix, which has grown into an industry-leading, multibillion-dollar cybersecurity company. The Role We are looking for a senior Applied AI Engineer to join Operations and improve how our business teams work. You will work directly with Support, Finance, Sales Ops, HR, IT, and Legal to turn repetitive tasks and disconnected workflows into reliable AI-powered tools and automations. We build AI to solve real problems, not to follow hype or impress investors. You will investigate how work gets done, propose improvements, and own technical decisions and delivery. We expect you to take initiative, deliver useful results quickly, and improve solutions through short iterations and feedback. What you’ll do Work with teams to understand their workflows, find bottlenecks, and propose improvements. Agree process changes with the COO and relevant teams before implementation. Build AI tools and automations that connect business systems and handle tasks such as document processing or ticket triage. Deliver working versions quickly and improve them through feedback. Prioritize opportunities by time saved, error reduction, and risk. Measure whether solutions deliver those benefits, reduce costs, and are actually used. Run and support what you build. Test AI outputs, keep integrations reliable as systems change, and manage failures, latency, and cost. Protect customer and employee data through limited access, minimal exposure, and redaction before model calls. Work with IT and Security on safeguards, audit trails, and human review where needed. Evaluate AI tools and vendors, and recommend when to use an existing solution versus building one. Document workflows and runbooks, train teams to use the solutions, and help them identify and request further automations. What we’re looking for 4+ years in operations engineering, business systems, automation, or a similar role, with 1+ years building production LLM or AI-enabled workflows. Hands-on experience with workflow automation platforms and REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth. Strong working knowledge of prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent/tool-use patterns. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript, and comfort with cloud services; AWS preferred. Experience with at least one major business system, such as NetSuite, Salesforce or ServiceNow. Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and explain trade-offs to non-technical leaders. Sound judgment and practical knowledge of AI security, privacy, and data governance, including least-privilege access, sensitive-data protection, data minimization, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Nice to have Experience with Microsoft 365 / Teams integrations and Microsoft Graph. Background in finance, revenue, or support operations processes. Familiarity with process mining, BI tools, or SQL. Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks. Relevant AWS, Azure, or security certifications. Familiarity with IT management, RMM, or endpoint security concepts. Experience shipping software with coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex, including harnesses, development loops, reusable skills, and context and specification management. Hands-on ownership of production backend services/APIs, with practical database and container experience. Systematic AI evaluation using datasets, metrics, baselines, reproducible experiments, and regression detection. Deeper ML foundations, statistical experimentation, and model training or fine-tuning. Experience with runtime isolation and sandboxing for sensitive execution. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: Understand key workflows and systems, and deliver a prioritized automation backlog First 90 days: Ship 3-5 production automations or integrations with measured impact, and publish AI usage and data-handling standards First year: Establish a repeatable intake-to-deployment process, show clear gains in hours saved and error reduction, and make AI tooling a trusted part of daily operations How We Measure Impact Hours saved, cycle-time reduction, error and rework rates, automation reliability (uptime and failure rate), AI cost per task, and stakeholder satisfaction. Benefits Fully remote work with flexibility to support your work-life balance. A collaborative environment that empowers you to own your domain and implement best practices. Stable income, benefits, flexible working hours, and opportunities for career advancement. Friendly, professional colleagues who are eager to support you and help you grow. Engaging challenges and opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

title: ICT-kehityspäällikkö, tekoälyn sääntelyvarmennus
description: Tekoälyn turvallisuus syntyy, kun sääntely-, viranomais-, tietosuoja- ja tietoturvan vaatimukset muuttuvat käytännön teoiksi.Haemme Digi- ja tekoälyinnovaatiot -tiimiimme ICT-kehityspäällikköä vastaamaan tekoälyn sääntelyvarmennuksesta.Ennakoit velvoitteet ja riskit, muutat ne toteutettaviksi vaatimuksiksi ja viet ratkaisut käytäntöön yhdessä asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Et jää osoittamaan puutteita, vaan autat ratkaisemaan ne ja varmistamaan vaatimusten täyttymisen. Mitä pääset tekemään?Johdat tekoälyratkaisujen vaatimustenmukaisuuden käytännön toteuttamista ja varmentamista yhteistyössä kehittäjien, toiminnan, juridiikan, tietosuojan, tietoturvan, riskienhallinnan ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.Tehtävässäsi: muutat sääntely-, viranomais-, tietosuoja- ja tietoturvavaatimukset käytännön kontrolleiksi, hyväksymiskriteereiksi ja toimintamalleiksi arvioit tekoälyratkaisujen riskejä ja vaikutuksia sekä määrittelet hallintatoimet jo suunnittelu- ja kehitysvaiheessa rakennat menetelmiä kontrollien toimivuuden ja vaatimusten täyttymisen testaamiseen, dokumentointiin ja osoittamiseen kokoat päätöksenteossa ja käyttöönotossa tarvittavan vaatimustenmukaisuusnäytön tunnistat puutteita ennakoivasti ja osallistut korjaavien ratkaisujen suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja varmentamiseen tuot vaatimustenmukaisuuden osaksi tekoälyratkaisujen kehitys-, hankinta-, käyttöönotto- ja elinkaariprosesseja.Tehtävässä ei ole suoria alaisia. Johdat verkostoissa tekoälyn sääntelyvarmennusta ja siihen liittyvää monialaista yhteistyötä. Odotamme sinulta: näyttöä puutteiden käytännön ratkaisemisesta yhteistyössä teknisten ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa kykyä viedä monialaisia kokonaisuuksia määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ilman muodollista esihenkilövaltaa ymmärrystä tekoäly-, data-, pilvi- ja ohjelmistoratkaisujen elinkaaresta sekä turvallisen kehittämisen periaatteista usean vuoden kokemusta vaatimustenmukaisuuden, riskienhallinnan, tietosuojan, tietoturvan tai teknologian varmennuksen tehtävistä EU:n tekoälysäädöksen ja GDPR:n hyvää tuntemusta sekä kykyä soveltaa niitä teknologia- ja kehittämisympäristössä kokemusta kontrollien, arviointikriteerien, riskienhallintatoimien tai vaatimustenmukaisuutta osoittavan dokumentaation rakentamisesta tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa TAI toisen asteen koulutusta yhdistettynä riittävään ammatilliseen perehtyneisyyteen.Tehtävä ei edellytä juridista tutkintoa tai tekoälymallien ohjelmointiosaamista. Tukenasi ovat sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon sääntelyn, ohjelmisto- ja tekoälykehityksen sekä toimittaja- ja sopimushallinnan asiantuntijat. Lisäksi arvostamme: ISO/IEC 42001-, ISO/IEC 23894-, ISO 27001- tai NIST AI Risk Management Framework -osaamista MDR-tuntemusta kokemusta tekoälyratkaisujen testauksesta, arvioinnista, validoinnista, auditoinnista tai laadunvarmistuksesta NIS2-sääntelyn sekä turvallisen ohjelmistokehityksen tai DevSecOps-toimintamallien tuntemusta kokemusta generatiivisesta tekoälystä, agenteista, Microsoft Copilotista tai Azure AI -palveluista Microsoft Purview-, Entra ID- tai Defender-ratkaisujen tuntemusta julkisen hallinnon tai sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimen toimintaympäristön tuntemusta tehtävää tukevia tietosuoja-, tietoturva-, riskienhallinta- tai auditointisertifikaatteja. Millainen henkilö menestyy tehtävässä?Näet sääntelyvaatimukset ratkaistavina suunnittelukysymyksinä, et etenemisen esteinä. Työskentelet ennakoivasti, konsultatiivisesti ja käytännönläheisesti myös monimutkaisessa sääntelyssä ja muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä. Löydät yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa toteuttamiskelpoisen reitin tavoitteeseen ja autat viemään tarvittavat toimet loppuun. Viestit ja teet yhteistyötä erilaisten asiantuntijoiden ja yhteistyötahojen kanssa sekä viet asioita eteenpäin myös keskeneräisessä ja nopeasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä. Tiimimme tavoitteena on saada turvalliset, vastuulliset ja vaikuttavat tekoälyratkaisut hallitusti käyttöön. Mitä tarjoamme?Tarjoamme kattavat työkyvyn tuen palvelut, modernit työvälineet sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ammattitaitoisessa ja kannustavassa työyhteisössä.Saat: merkityksellisen työn suomalaisen hyvinvointisektorin digitalisaation kärjessä ammatistaan ylpeän työyhteisön ja kannustavan ilmapiirin joustoa työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamiseen, mukaan lukien Väestöliiton Perheystävällinen työpaikka -ohjelman mukaiset toimintatavat kattavat työterveyspalvelut henkilöstöetuja ja virkistystoimintaa, kuten lomaedut ja tyhy-päivät työntekijäyhdistys Pähe ry:n jäsenyyden vapaa-ajan etuineen. Tehtävän käytännön tiedot Toimipiste sijaitsee Lahdessa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä. Hybridityö mahdollistaa tehtävän luonne huomioiden noin 60 prosentin etätyön. Työaika on 36,25 tuntia viikossa, ja käytössä ovat joustavat työaikaliukumat. Lomaoikeus voi työkokemuksen karttuessa olla jopa 38 arkipäivää vuodessa. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Tehtävään voi sisältyä vähäistä matkustamista. Muut tiedotTyöskentelykielemme on suomi. Odotamme sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa.Valittavasta henkilöstä tehdään hänen suostumuksellaan henkilöturvallisuusselvitys turvallisuusselvityslain 726/2014 mukaisesti. Kiinnostuitko?Kerro hakemuksessasi esimerkein: miten olet muuttanut sääntely- tai riskienhallintavaatimuksia käytännön kontrolleiksi miten olet rakentanut vaatimusten täyttymisen osoittavaa näyttöä miten olet auttanut ratkaisemaan havaitun puutteen käytännössä.Voit tiedustella tehtävästä puhelimitse tai LinkedIn-viestillä.Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian.Anna tarinasi jatkua Päijät-Hämeessä. title: Salesforce Technical Business Analyst (Poland)
description: The Opportunity Flosum is looking for a visionary Salesforce Technical Business Analyst who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce. This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem. We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first. About Flosum Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards. Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match. We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build. What You Will Own Product Vision & Strategy Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva. Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors. Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for. Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift. AI & Innovation Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management. Define how Flosum's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary. Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents. Customer & Market Insight Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management. Translate complex enterprise requirements (SOX, zero-trust, multi-org, regulated industries) into elegant product solutions. Partner with Sales and Customer Success to influence deal strategy, conduct product demos for strategic accounts, and close competitive evaluations. Execution & Delivery Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You do the work, not just delegate it. Partner with engineering to deliver on aggressive timelines. Own sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release coordination. Define and track product KPIs: adoption, activation, expansion, NPS, competitive win rates. Who You Are We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary. Someone who takes genuine ownership of outcomes, thinks independently, and is driven by a need to build something that matters, not just advance their career. 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms. Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem. Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products. Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred. You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable. Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape. Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance. Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day. Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it. What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company. You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries. You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics. You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce. You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend. What We Expect in the First 12 Months First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose Achieve deep fluency in Flosum's five product lines and their technical architecture. Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points. Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win. Deliver your first product roadmap refresh with clear prioritization rationale. Months 3-6: Ship and Win Own and deliver at least one major product release that directly addresses a competitive gap or customer-requested capability. Establish a product-led feedback loop between Sales, CS, and Engineering that accelerates deal velocity and reduces churn. Define the next generation of Flosum's AI capabilities and present a detailed execution plan. Months 6-12: Scale and Lead Drive measurable improvement in competitive win rates against Copado and Gearset. Launch at least one net-new product capability that opens a new revenue stream or market segment. Establish Flosum as a thought leader in AI-driven Salesforce DevOps through content, speaking, and ecosystem engagement.

title: Network System Engineer
description: ABOUT BETBY As a fast-growing, award-winning company, Betby powers the industry with our premium sportsbook, featuring world-class risk management and seamless omni-channel support, reaching millions of players across countless markets. With offices in Latvia, Malta, Spain, Greece and Montenegro, we offer a vibrant work culture, relocation opportunities, and full support for remote talent across the globe. Join Betby and unlock endless opportunities for growth, success, and making a real impact in the world of iGaming! SHORT DESCRIPTION We are looking for a experienced Scala Engineer to join our Line management team at BETBY. The team is building and maintaining platform that delivers betting odds to the sportsbook. This is a high-impact role within a cross-functional environment, working closely with multiple teams and services. RESPONSIBILITIES Routing & Traffic Management: Deploy, maintain and optimize our Linux-based routing stack, ensure fault tolerance and security. Virtualization Networking: Manage network configurations on Proxmox hosts, including the automation and maintenance of LACP bonds, Linux bridges, VLAN tagging and etc. Hybrid Cloud Connectivity: Design, deploy, and maintain secure connectivity of our on-premise bare-metal clusters with Cloud resources (VPCs) and across multiple data centers. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate the deployment of network configurations (bonding, interfaces, BIRD configs) to ensure consistency across the fleet and reduce manual intervention. Security & Microsegmentation: Implement and refine firewall rules/security groups to maintain strict microsegmentation and protect internal assets. Performance Monitoring: Proactively monitor interface throughput, latency, and routing stability. Troubleshoot complex L2/L3 issues in a multi-DC environment. title: Are you passionate about crisis management, emergency preparedness and building organizational resilience in a global organization?
description: We are looking for an experienced and motivated Global Security Manager – Crisis Management to strengthen our global security and resilience capability. In this role, your main responsibility will be crisis management and business continuity , you will work close with our team, and also be involved in a variety of security areas such as personnel security, physical security, information security and travel security.  You will have a key responsibility for further developing our global approach to crisis management and emergency preparedness. You will work closely with management, security professionals, business units and functions across the organization to ensure that we are prepared to respond effectively when serious incidents occur.The position combines strategic development, governance and hands-on operational crisis management , and requires someone who is comfortable working both proactively and in situations where time, information and predictability may be limited. Your key responsibilities: Develop, maintain and continuously improve the company’s global Crisis Management framework , including governance, processes, plans and supporting tools. Support and further develop the organization’s Emergency Response and Crisis Management structure globally. Support the establishment and development of local and regional emergency response capabilities, crisis management exercises and training for management teams and relevant functions. Contribute to the broader development of Business Continuity Management and organizational resilience . Together with the Security team you will monitor relevant global developments and emerging risks that may affect our people and operations. Participate in operational crisis response when required, as a important coordinating role in the global crisis management team. Collaborate with the Travel Security Board team.   We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today! At Kongsberg Maritime , we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!   What we are looking for: We believe you have solid experience within crisis management, emergency preparedness, security, resilience or related disciplines , combined with the ability to translate frameworks and requirements into practical solutions.Relevant experience may come from international industry, corporate security, emergency preparedness, defence, police, public authorities or consulting.We are particularly interested in candidates who have: Experience with crisis management and emergency response in a complex organization. Experience developing crisis management plans, frameworks and response structures. Experience planning and facilitating exercises, training and scenario-based crisis management activities. Experience supporting management during serious incidents or crises. Strong understanding of crisis leadership, decision-making and coordination under pressure. Ability to work across organizational, geographical and cultural boundaries. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Excellent written and spoken English. Experience from an international organization with global operations will be considered an advantage.Knowledge of recognized standards and good practices within crisis management and business continuity, including ISO 22301 and ISO 27001, will also be beneficial.  This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces. Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub). Job Description Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide. Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies. This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning. Responsibilities Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives. Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team. Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery. Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately. Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues. Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies. Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks. Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery. Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery. Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission. Required qualifications Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains: SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security. LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity. GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope. IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security. 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course. You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently. Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams. Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience. Practical experience analyzing telecom signaling traces and using packet-analysis tools such as Wireshark. Confidence working with Linux-based lab environments and troubleshooting connectivity or exercise issues. Professional preparation, reliable delivery, and clear communication with clients and the P1 Security team. Willingness and ability to travel internationally for short-term onsite engagements: typically around five days per mission including travel, with some engagements requiring up to two weeks onsite. Preferred qualifications Experience in telecom security consulting, penetration testing, incident response, signaling monitoring, or mobile core network operations. Familiarity with 3GPP security specifications and relevant GSMA signaling security guidance. Experience with signaling firewalls, roaming and interconnect security, or telecom threat detection. Experience adapting digital learning content into instructor-led courses and practical exercises. Familiarity with virtualized or containerized lab environments and scripting for lab preparation. Experience teaching international audiences or working across different cultural and organizational contexts. Language requirements Fluent professional English, with the ability to deliver technical instruction and facilitate discussions. Additional languages are a plus, including French. Engagement details Contract type: Freelance, on a per-mission basis. Delivery location: Onsite at client locations worldwide. Mission duration: Typically around five days including travel; some engagements may require up to two weeks onsite. Headquarters: Paris, France. Training materials: Established curriculum and lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform, adapted for each classroom engagement. Commercial arrangements: Scope, preparation time, delivery dates, fees, and travel and accommodation arrangements to be agreed for each mission. Hiring process First contact call (10-20min) Direct manager call (30min) Capability assessment exercice (depending on position) C-level & Director call (30 min) Contact If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field. To apply, please send your CV or professional profile and a short introduction highlighting your telecom security expertise and training experience. Include the protocols and courses you can teach, examples of previous workshops or audiences, your availability, your location and travel flexibility, and your indicative daily rate. Please do not include confidential client information. title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
description: Who we are ? Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools. The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment. Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes. A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components. Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework. Your main responsibilities will include : Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. They must also be fluent in English and able to develop, train, evaluate, test and document AI components within a collaborative environment. Experience in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP/LLM), graph learning, learning-guided search or the deployment of machine learning models would be an advantage. An interest in formal verification, cybersecurity, trustworthy AI, Docker and teaching activities would also be appreciated. The role also requires strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as a good team spirit. The candidate must be able to communicate clearly, explain technical concepts in layman’s terms, draft documentation and contribute to teaching activities. Required qualifications and experience : the candidate must hold a five-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+5) or equivalent. Applications from candidates with a four-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+4) and at least four years’ professional experience, a three-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+3) and at least six years’ experience, or a two-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+2) and at least ten years’ experience will also be considered. Why join us? You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from : 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT) flexible working hours (depending on department activity) telecommuting 1 to 3 days/week possible 75% public transport pass reimbursement Proximity to numerous sports facilities, concierge service, underground parking, in-house catering, etc. Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector Remuneration details: Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
description: The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute , University of Southern Denmark , invites applications for a Research Assistant position . The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027,  or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months. The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education , a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU). CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.   About the position Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed. This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results.  Responsibility and opportunities Concretely, you can expect to: Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand. Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined. Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy. Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration. Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.   Required scientific qualifications A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement. Qualifications Required Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available. An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience. Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials. Personal competences Craft in making things others will use.  You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document. A service orientation towards instructors . Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument. Organized and self-directed.  You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you. Comfort with iteration.  The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job. Integrity and care in working with students.  You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.   Workplace description   The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering . We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously. You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg , sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points:  VisitSønderborg  for the area itself, and  Hej Sønderborg , an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.   Further information   Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami , at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk . If you experience technical problems, please contact  our email support .   Application Applicants are advised to read the  SDU information on how to apply . Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:  Motivated application. Curriculum Vitae.  Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation).  Complete list of publications, if you have any. Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2). Up to two references (can be supplied later in the hiring process). A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).    The application deadline is December 9, 2026,  at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)   Assessment and selection process Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment.  Read about shortlisting at SDU.   Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the  Assessment and selection process .     Employment terms Appointment as a research assistant is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.  Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein.  Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.  Further information on salary and taxation.   Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.   The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s). Further information  for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark  for additional information. Further information  about The Faculty of Engineering.

TRAVEL The contractor will be expected to undertake business travel in support of specification development and coordination activities with NATO stakeholders. Demonstrated experience (5+ years) in post-related field. Knowledge of NATO’s internal structures, decision-making processes, stakeholder environment and civil-military working practices, gained through relevant professional experience is desirable. The contractor must have proven communication and negotiation skills matured within a large international environment. 8. title: DevOps Engineer
description: We have a strong and growing product development organization made up of experienced professionals and talented junior engineers. Our product roadmap is healthy well into the future, offering a variety of technically meaningful challenges. To support our long-term roadmap and ambitious technology goals, we are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to help develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable efficient, secure, and high-quality software and product delivery. We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in DevOps toolchains, automation, CI/CD, and Kubernetes-based platforms. **Your** **role** As a **DevOps Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the development infrastructure used throughout the product lifecycle, including the underlying network connectivity and security controls. The environment includes source code and artifact management, build and release automation, test infrastructure, Kubernetes-based platforms, and integrations supporting requirements management, verification, validation, and product releases. You will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline development workflows and introduce modern tools and practices that support developers in their daily work. **Main Responsibilities** - Maintain and continuously improve the development environment and DevOps toolchain, manage source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact repositories. - Design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient network connectivity for development, build, test and deployment environments and troubleshoot issues. - Support network architecture and configuration for Kubernetes-based platforms, including ingress controls, load balancing, DNS, service connectivity, network policies and certificate management. - Ensure development infrastructure complies with relevant standards, cybersecurity requirements, and regulations. - Automate manual processes and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, reliability, traceability, and quality. - Integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and compliance checks into the software development lifecycle. - Evaluate, implement, and support AI-powered tools that enhance developer productivity. - Administer developer tools and software, integrate development data sources to provide clear visibility and reporting across the product development lifecycle. **Your profile** Our ideal candidate has a strong background in DevOps, automation, and software development tooling. You are a proactive, hands-on professional who can apply industry best practices to modern, highly secure and regulated engineering environments. **Required Skills** - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent. - Minimum five years of relevant experience in DevOps, Build Engineering, Software Tooling, or a similar role. - Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, TLS/PKI, and network segmentation. - Experience with DevOps technologies such as GitLab, Git, Docker, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar. - Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes. - Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes-based container platforms. - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure software development, open-source software governance, and DevSecOps practices. - Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions. - Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar). - Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken. We do not expect you to meet every requirement listed above. If you have a strong DevOps background, a hands-on mindset, and experience in many of the areas described, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges just as much as experience with specific tools. **What you will be part of** Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of Saab Surveillance business area. Our R&D teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people safe**. As an example of a brilliant product we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact! We support flexible ways of working and offer opportunities for occasional remote work when the nature of the tasks allows. As a DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to continuously improve our development platforms, tools, and processes. Because of this close collaboration and the nature of our development environment, most work is carried out on-site at our modern Saab Technology Center in Tampere. On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options. In this job, some of your tasks have a connection to defense secrecy. Therefore, a drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance act 726/2014 is required for the selected applicant. **Why join us?** - Play a key role in enabling the development of cutting-edge electronic warfare systems - Work with modern DevOps technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and automation solutions - Take ownership of processes and solutions that directly support product development and delivery - Collaborate with highly skilled software, systems, and engineering professionals - Grow your expertise through continuous learning, training opportunities, and challenging technical projects We are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides. **Interested?** Take your chance to build your future career at Saab by submitting your CV and application via Saab Careers already now!
